sentences.display: Al-Ṭabarī weighed these views, and concluded that Iram was most likely the name of a tribe of ʿĀd.
sentences.tts: Al-Tabari weighed these views, and concluded that إِرَم was most likely the name of a tribe of عَاد.

sentences.display: Then he turned to the pillars.
sentences.tts: Then he turned to the pillars.
